mechanism: Tramadol is a serotonergic agent (inhibits reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine) and weak CYP3A4/2D6 substrate; armodafinil is a CYP3A4 inducer that may increase tramadol metabolism while both drugs increase CNS stimulation and seizure risk.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms and reduced tramadol efficacy; avoid concurrent use if possible or use lowest effective tramadol dose with clinical monitoring.
